key_highlights: Global risk assets staged a major Thanksgiving week rebound, with the S&P 500 logging its best week since April 2025 and emerging markets posting their strongest rally since June, propelled by a sharp recovery in beaten-down technology shares.

Primary focus must be directed toward rising trade policy friction: newly proposed tariffs targeting China, the EU, and other trade partners threaten global supply chains and inflation expectations despite easing near-term selling pressure.

The US Dollar Index is pacing for its longest consecutive winning streak since 2024, driving Treasury yields higher as haven bond demand wanes, while plunging fuel prices offer critical disinflationary relief to central banks.

China delivered its largest single-day equity surge since 2024 following an unexpected midday state pledge, catalyzing a seven-month high in copper prices and stabilizing broader Asian equity bourses.

AI market dynamics show high bifurcation: Anthropic reclaimed its $83 IPO level (closing at $91.88, +11%) and hardware/infra continues seeing state support, yet enterprise deployment headwinds are mounting, evidenced by 95% project failure rates and SAP weighing 10,000 AI-driven job cuts.

sectors.trend: Aggressive short-covering and dip-buying into core AI hardware and recently listed foundational models, countered by enterprise implementation bottlenecks.
sectors.implications: Capital is concentrating in mission-critical hardware, sovereign AI initiatives, and high-touch deployment models (Forward Deployed Engineers), while pure software firms face intense cost restructuring and job rationalization.

sectors.trend: Broad-based stabilization and regional outperformance across Asia and Latin America following state-backed market interventions and technocratic fiscal appointments.
sectors.implications: China's midday intervention and Brazil's appointment of a veteran banker as finance minister spark immediate capital inflows, driving the Brazilian Real to its best weekly gain since 2020 and lifting EM benchmarks.

sectors.trend: Persistent US Dollar dominance paired with a retreat in sovereign safe-haven bonds as risk appetite returns.
sectors.implications: Rising US Treasury yields reflect reduced recession hedging and growing wariness of tariff-induced inflation, placing selective pressure on weaker frontier currencies like the Colombian peso.

sectors.trend: Industrial metals surging alongside risk appetite while refined fuel prices plunge.
sectors.implications: Copper's sharpest jump in seven months signals manufacturing optimism from Chinese policy pledges, whereas collapsing fuel prices directly suppress headline consumer price indices, aiding global central bank rate cut paths.

sectors.trend: Black Friday retail launches under a dual-track spending paradigm: value-seeking behavior and booming low-ticket indulgences ('little treat' economy).
sectors.implications: Retailers like Best Buy and luxury conglomerates must rely on heavy promotional strategies to drive volumes against persistent cumulative inflation, while discretionary impulse categories see resilient micro-spend.

sectors.trend: Heightened national security vulnerabilities across critical sovereign IT infrastructure.
sectors.implications: Direct penetration of US Air Force computing infrastructure elevates defense IT audits and accelerates mandatory federal allocations toward zero-trust defense architectures.

key_themes: AI Reality Check vs. Hardware Exuberance: Polarization between record infrastructure funding and enterprise software adoption friction.
Macro Tariff Resurgence: Emerging trade protectionism creating an overhang on global growth and supply chain continuity.
Disinflationary Tailwinds from Energy: Plunging fuel prices dampening headline inflation pressures across Western economies.
State-Driven Market Rescues: Decisive regulatory and fiscal interventions stabilizing Chinese equities and Brazilian asset valuations.
Asset Rotation from Havens to Cyclicals: Treasuries and defensive postures unwinding in favor of high-beta tech, copper, and EM equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: New Tariff Waves on Major Trade Partners
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight tariff-exposed multinational exporters; overweight domestic-centric small/mid caps and secure bilateral trade beneficiaries.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Enterprise AI Deployment Failure & Software CapEx Pullback
risk_assessment.mitigation: Pivot tech exposure from unproven software wrappers to mission-critical semiconductor hardware, specialized AI storage, and field-engineering integrators.
Hedge extended beta using short-dated protective collars or cash reserves ahead of seasonal year-end tax-loss harvesting and liquidity drains.
Avoid opaque regional wealth management products and secondary private credit vehicles showing defaults or heightened regulatory intervention.
Increase allocations to government-accredited cybersecurity providers and zero-trust cloud network security specialists.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalize on Industrial Metals & China Policy Stimulus
opportunities.rationale: China's decisive policy support combined with a 7-month high breakout in copper signals renewed cyclical upside for industrial commodities and base metal producers.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate Tier-1 AI Infrastructure and Foundational Leaders
opportunities.rationale: Battered tech rebound, Anthropic's successful recovery above its $83 IPO mark ($91.88), and political support for key chip leaders reaffirm foundational compute demand.

opportunities.recommendation: Allocate to Latin American Value & Fiscal Turnaround Assets
opportunities.rationale: Brazil's market-friendly finance minister appointment and historic weekly real surge, alongside real estate trust issuance in Mexico, highlight compelling risk-reward in selected LatAm assets.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in Transport and Margin Beneficiaries of Plunging Fuel
opportunities.rationale: Collapsing fuel prices deliver substantial operating margin expansion for freight, logistics, and airline carriers entering peak holiday volumes.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain Long US Dollar Positioning via Currency Instruments
defensive_moves.rationale: The greenback's longest winning run since 2024 and impending tariff implementation support sustained USD outperformance against G10 and vulnerable EM peers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Long-Duration Treasuries and Rotate into Ultra-Short Yield
defensive_moves.rationale: Treasury sell-off driven by rising risk appetite and tariff-related inflation overhang makes long duration unattractive relative to high-yielding cash equivalents.
Consumer divergence toward discount deals and micro-indulgences creates margin compression for mid-tier retailers facing sticky inflation and potential tariff pass-throughs.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautiously constructive with near-term consolidation risk (1-3 months). Although the Thanksgiving rebound in tech and S&P 500 signals strong underlying momentum, markets face technical exhaustion, December tax-loss rebalancing, and tariff frictions before establishing a durable January breakout.
market_outlook.long_term: Positive growth trajectory (6-12 months). Easing headline inflation via falling fuel costs, industrial CapEx resurgence ('golden age for builders'), and ongoing deployment of next-gen AI compute will expand operating margins globally, provided tariff escalation remains contained.
key_catalysts: Official publication and implementation timeline of proposed tariffs on China, EU, and key trading partners.
Final Black Friday and Cyber Monday gross merchandise value (GMV) metrics assessing consumer resilience.
Federal Reserve December FOMC policy decision incorporating plunging fuel prices versus tariff-driven inflation risks.
Enterprise software restructuring updates and Forward-Deployed Engineer adoption rates across major tech companies.
Follow-through on China's midday market stabilization vow and subsequent fiscal policy announcements.
watch_list: US Dollar Index (DXY) momentum and duration of its historic winning streak.
US 10-Year Treasury Yield behavior as safe-haven bond demand fluctuates.
Copper and base metal price continuation following seven-month high breakouts.
Anthropic post-IPO secondary market stability and private AI valuation benchmarks.
WTI and Brent crude futures price action and refining margins.
